2609.30264.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
2609.30264.paper_summary: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information. Both objectives encourage planning transitions to preserve action information; their auxiliary heads are discarded at test time, leaving MPC unchanged. On OGBench-Cube, AD-WM improves hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline and improves mean success over the reproduced baseline in four of five simulation environments. Planning diagnostics show that factual prediction error and whole-bank action ranking do not follow the closed-loop success ordering, whereas CEM-aligned elite regret tracks success more closely. With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, AD-WM also improves zero-shot transfer to our Franka setup, increasing basic pick-and-place success from 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation. These results suggest that world models for planning should preserve action-dependent differences needed for counterfactual selection, rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone. More videos and code are available at https://ad-wm.github.io/.
2609.30264.paper_summary_zh: 潛在世界模型通常被訓練以預測事實轉換，而模型預測控制（MPC）必須比較來自同一狀態的替代行動。因此，一個模型可以實現低的事實預測誤差，但卻無法良好區分候選行動。我們介紹了AD-WM，一種針對反事實MPC的行動區分聯合嵌入世界模型。AD-WM結合了殘差潛在動力學與預測者級別的行動恢復正則化，使用逆動力學和由條件互信息驅動的標準化恢復目標。這兩個目標都鼓勵規劃轉換以保留行動信息；它們的輔助頭在測試時被丟棄，使MPC保持不變。在OGBench-Cube上，AD-WM將硬啟動成功率從3.7%提高到52.0%，超過了匹配的LeWM基線，並在五個模擬環境中的四個中改善了平均成功率。規劃診斷顯示，事實預測誤差和整體銀行行動排名並不遵循閉環成功排序，而CEM對齊的精英後悔則更密切地追蹤成功。使用凍結的V-JEPA 2編碼器和匹配的DROID後訓練，AD-WM還改善了對我們的Franka設置的零樣本轉移，將基本的拾取和放置成功率從42.2%提高到71.1%，而無需實驗室特定的適應。這些結果表明，規劃的世界模型應該保留反事實選擇所需的行動依賴差異，而不僅僅是優化事實預測準確性。更多視頻和代碼可在 https://ad-wm.github.io/ 獲得。
